review.posthog_relevance: Support tier display and response time configuration, specifically the replacement of helper-dependent conditional rendering with a consolidated row-based data structure.
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F2.H1 demonstrates a refactoring of support response time display, replacing inline conditional checks and removed helper functions with a centralized row-based structure. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in maintainability and consistency for the billing/support configuration display, warranting a score of 2. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction
review.uncertainty: The chunk lacks the implementation of removed helper functions and complete replacement context, preventing full assessment of the complete behavior and potential edge cases. The score relies solely on the visible replacement pattern.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the removed helper functions (getCurrentSupportPlan, getSupportResponseTimeFeature, PAY_AS_YOU_GO_RESPONSE_TIME, DEFAULT_PAID_RESPONSE_TIME) nor the complete context of the billing constants or the complete component rendering. The score cannot be assigned without seeing the removed code and the complete replacement implementation,

observations.behavior: Replacement of a plan-specific, conditional rendering and helper-dependent support response time table with a consolidated, row-based data structure.
observations.posthog_connection: Support tier display and response time configuration. The replacement function getSupportPlanRows centralizes the response time configuration and current plan detection, removing the previous inline conditional checks and plan-specific object construction. This could improve maintainability and reduce the risk of inconsistencies between the support tier and the displayed response,
